sentences.en: The emphasis is on comfort level in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 但佩洛西在这里的另一个目标是试图组建一个在地区和种族上具有多样性的团队。

sentences.en: The stated goal was to try and put together a team with a lot of courtroom experience.
sentences.zh: 所以你有来自沿海地区、纽约和加利福尼亚的议员。

sentences.en: So you have lawyers and prosecutors in Garcia.
sentences.zh: 你有黑人议员和拉丁裔议员。

sentences.en: You have somebody that was part of the judicial system in Texas.
sentences.zh: 你还有来自中部地区的人。

sentences.en: She wanted a team that was going to be ready to argue this case, to put together briefs in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 例如，杰森·克劳来自科罗拉多州。

sentences.en: But Pelosi's other goal here was to try and put together a team that was regionally and ethnically diverse.
sentences.zh: 加西亚来自德克萨斯州，而且是拉丁裔。

sentences.en: So you have lawmakers from the coast, from New York and California.
sentences.zh: 所以她试图组建一个看起来更像民主党核心小组和整个国家的团队，而不是一群沿海精英或法律精英，

sentences.en: You have black lawmakers and Latino lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 或者像1999年起诉比尔·克林顿的那个管理人团队，那可是13个白人男性。

sentences.en: And you have folks from the middle of the country.
sentences.zh: 13个白人男性。

sentences.en: Jason Crow, for instance, is from Colorado.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Garcia is from Texas, in addition to being Latino.
sentences.zh: 来自众议院司法委员会的13名白人男性将针对比尔·克林顿的案件带到了众议院。

sentences.en: So she was looking to put together basically a team that looks something like the Democratic caucus and the country as a whole, rather than a set of coastals or legal elites,
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: or like the team of managers that prosecuted Bill Clinton in 1999, 13 white guys.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尼克，我很好奇。

sentences.en: Thirteen white guys.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党众议员来说是一个令人向往的任务吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 还是人们避之不及的工作？

sentences.en: Thirteen white men from the House Judiciary Committee brought the case against Bill Clinton over to the House.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: You know, Nick, I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: Is this a desirable assignment for a House Democrat?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: Or is this a job people run from?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: You know, I think it's a very desirable assignment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常令人向往的任务。

sentences.en: And you need no look farther than the fact that many lawmakers put their own names forward, wrote letters to Speaker Pelosi asking to be included on this team.
sentences.zh: 你只需看看这一点就明白了：许多议员主动请缨，写信给佩洛西议长，要求加入这个团队。

sentences.en: Because these seven Democrats are now basically going to become the face of the House's case.
sentences.zh: 因为这七位民主党人现在基本上将成为众议院控方的门面。

sentences.en: They will be the ones writing briefs, but more importantly, arguing on the floor of the Senate as to why President Trump's behavior warrants impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他们将负责撰写法律文书，但更重要的是，他们将在参议院辩论为何特朗普总统的行为应当被弹劾。

sentences.en: And they're going to be all over TVs across the country.
sentences.zh: 而且他们将出现在全国各地的电视屏幕上。

sentences.en: There's the potential here for many of these folks for this to be a career defining moment.
sentences.zh: 对于这些人中的许多人来说，这有可能成为他们职业生涯中的决定性时刻。

sentences.en: You know, Lindsey Graham, who's now a very well-known member of the Senate and a confidant of the president, his career got its big boost when he was one of those 13 House managers
sentences.zh: 你知道，林赛·格雷厄姆现在是参议院非常有名的议员，也是总统的亲信，他的职业生涯正是因为在1999年担任那13位众议院弹劾经理人之一而获得了巨大的提升。
那是1999年的事。

sentences.en: So this is a important and historic role.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个重要且具有历史意义的角色。

sentences.en: You know, there will be books written about this as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于这件事也会有书籍出版。

sentences.en: And to be a member of that team is to have a role in potentially at least history.
sentences.zh: 能成为那个团队的一员，意味着在某种程度上参与了历史。

sentences.en: But I don't think we could be better served than by the patriotism and dedication of the managers that I am naming here this morning.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，我今天早上任命的这些经理人的爱国精神和奉献精神，是我们所能得到的最好的人选。

sentences.en: Thank you all very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Okay, so once these managers are announced, what happens after this news conference?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么在这些经理人宣布之后，新闻发布会结束后会发生什么？

sentences.en: Pretty quickly, Pelosi and her team of seven walk upstairs to the floor of the House, the chamber where...
sentences.zh: 很快，佩洛西和她的七人团队就会走上楼，前往众议院议事厅，那个……

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, pursuant to House Resolution 767,
sentences.zh: 议长女士，根据众议院第767号决议，

sentences.en: I now send to the desk a resolution anointing and authorizing managers for the impeachment trial of Donald John Trump...
sentences.zh: 我现在向主席台提交一份决议，任命并授权唐纳德·约翰·特朗普弹劾案的经理人……

sentences.en: The House votes along the same party lines that it did a month ago when it approved the articles to formally appoint the managers and bring the case to trial.
sentences.zh: 众议院以一个月前批准弹劾条款时相同的党派立场投票，正式任命了经理人并将案件提交审判。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 228, the nays are 193.
sentences.zh: 本次投票结果为赞成228票，反对193票。

sentences.en: The resolution is adopted and without objection...
sentences.zh: 决议获得通过，且无异议……

sentences.en: And that is really the last vote that the House officially needs to take on this matter.
sentences.zh: 这确实是众议院在此事上需要正式进行的最后一次投票。

sentences.en: It's now up to the managers to bring their case forward, and a Senate trial is imminent.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到经理人提出他们的诉求了，参议院的审判迫在眉睫。

sentences.en: Nick, at this point, as we're talking, it is 3.40 p.m.
sentences.zh: 尼克，此时此刻，我们交谈的时间是下午3点40分。

sentences.en: on Wednesday after that vote to approve the House managers and transmit the articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 周三，在批准众议院经理人并移交弹劾条款的投票之后。

sentences.en: So what is the next step?
sentences.zh: 那么下一步是什么？

sentences.en: So Speaker Pelosi and the managers will reconvene now at 5 o'clock and begin basically the carefully
sentences.zh: 佩洛西议长和经理人们将于5点重新集合，开始进行基本上是精心编排的

sentences.en: choreographed exchange of the articles between the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 众议院和参议院之间的弹劾条款移交程序。

sentences.en: First, the speaker will sign the articles in what is called, as only Congress could put it, an engrossment ceremony.
sentences.zh: 首先，议长将签署这些条款，进行所谓的——只有国会才会这么叫的——“正式誊写仪式”。

sentences.en: From there, the managers will line up with the sergeant-at-arms of the House and the clerk of the
sentences.zh: 此后，经理人们将与众议院警卫官和众议院书记官排成队列，

sentences.en: House, and they will process out of the House, through the old House chamber, through the rotunda
sentences.zh: 他们将列队走出众议院，穿过旧众议院议事厅，穿过国会大厦的圆形大厅，

sentences.en: of the Capitol, over to the Senate to meet the secretary of the Senate and hand over a communication.
sentences.zh: 前往参议院，会见参议院秘书并递交一份公文。

sentences.en: The Senate will receive a message from the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 参议院将收到来自众议院的消息。

sentences.en: Saying they are essentially ready to come to trial.
sentences.zh: 告知他们基本上已经准备好进行审判了。

sentences.en: A message from the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 来自众议院的消息。

sentences.en: And hand over a nicely printed copy of their articles of impeachment for the Senate.
sentences.zh: 并为参议院递交一份印制精美的弹劾条款副本。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I have been directed by the House of Representatives to inform the Senate.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我受众议院指派，通知参议院。

sentences.en: And so then the next step is basically to start a trial.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来的步骤基本上就是开始审判。

sentences.en: Only the third such proceeding in American history, where a president of the United States will be potentially convicted or acquitted of high crimes and misdemeanors.
sentences.zh: 这是美国历史上第三次此类诉讼，美国总统可能因重罪和轻罪而被定罪或宣告无罪。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载

sentences.en: Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So Nick, now that the impeachment moves from the House to the Senate, what does that process look like over in the Senate?
sentences.zh: 那么尼克，既然弹劾案从众议院移交到了参议院，参议院那边的程序是什么样的？

sentences.en: Walk us through it.
sentences.zh: 给我们介绍一下吧。

sentences.en: So on Thursday, the trial will begin.
sentences.zh: 周四，审判将正式开始。

sentences.en: And it starts with quite a bit more ceremony.
sentences.zh: 而且开始时会有更多的仪式感。

sentences.en: The
sentences.zh: 众议院

sentences.en: House impeachment managers will once again walk over from the House to the Senate, carrying their articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 弹劾经理人将再次从众议院步行前往参议院，携带他们的弹劾条款。

sentences.en: And this time they'll enter the Senate chamber and meet the sergeant-at-arms, who will give a stern warning to the senators.
sentences.zh: 这一次他们将进入参议院议事厅，会见警卫官，警卫官将对参议员们发出严厉的警告。

sentences.en: He'll cry out, hear ye, hear ye.
sentences.zh: 他会高喊：听着，听着。

sentences.en: Now you know we're firmly in the territory of old American traditions, right?
sentences.zh: 现在你知道我们已经完全进入了古老的美国传统领域，对吧？

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: He will warn senators that from here on out, as long as the Senate is sitting in trial, they cannot speak, quote, on pain of imprisonment, if they do.
sentences.zh: 他将警告参议员们，从现在开始，只要参议院在进行审判，他们就不能说话，引用的话说，如果说话，“将面临监禁”。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It was a serious business.
sentences.zh: 这是件严肃的事情。

sentences.en: Senators are all expected to be in their desk.
sentences.zh: 参议员们都被要求坐在自己的座位上。

sentences.en: And then the managers will process up into the center of the Senate, and they'll read aloud their articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 然后经理人们将列队进入参议院中心，大声宣读他们的弹劾条款。

sentences.en: I just want to understand this.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄明白这一点。

sentences.en: So throughout the trial, House members will be going into the Senate and doing the talking.
sentences.zh: 所以整个审判过程中，众议院议员们会进入参议院并进行陈述。

sentences.en: And the senators will, under pain of imprisonment, remain absolutely mum, which is kind of an interesting situation for the senators.
sentences.zh: 而参议员们在面临监禁的威胁下，必须保持绝对沉默，这对参议员来说是一个相当有趣的情况。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a very uncomfortable situation for senators who like to do their own talking.
sentences.zh: 对于那些喜欢自己发言的参议员来说，这是一个非常不舒服的情况。

sentences.en: Not only can they not speak, they won't be able to bring electronics into the chamber for hours at a time.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅不能说话，而且在数小时内不能将电子设备带入议事厅。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They will have to remain seated at their desks.
sentences.zh: 他们必须一直坐在自己的座位上。

sentences.en: When they are allowed to ask questions, they have to do so in writing.
sentences.zh: 当他们被允许提问时，必须以书面形式进行。

sentences.en: And if senators want to debate, say, a motion before a vote, what they actually do is kick out reporters and the cameras, and they close the doors of the
sentences.zh: 如果参议员们想要辩论，比如在投票前提出动议，他们实际上会把记者和摄像机赶出去，关闭

sentences.en: Senate and have that debate in private.
sentences.zh: 参议院的大门，进行闭门辩论。

sentences.en: So this is not a proceeding like any that I think any of us, including me covering Congress, are familiar with.
sentences.zh: 所以这与我认为我们任何人，包括我自己在内报道国会时所熟悉的任何程序都不一样。

sentences.en: It's really about the House managers and the president's defense lawyers arguing it out in front of the Senate, which serves as both kind of a judge and a jury.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是众议院经理人和总统的辩护律师在参议院面前进行辩论，参议院既充当法官又充当陪审团。

sentences.en: Just a very silent version of that.
sentences.zh: 只是一个非常安静的版本。

sentences.en: A very silent one.
sentences.zh: 非常安静的版本。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the House managers have the floor Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以众议院经理人在周四上午有发言权。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so they are introduced formally to the Senate, and the Senate summons next John
sentences.zh: 他们被正式介绍给参议院，接下来参议院传唤约翰·罗伯茨，

sentences.en: Roberts, the chief justice of the Supreme Court, to come over to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 最高法院首席大法官，来到参议院。

sentences.en: He takes an oath himself and then administers an oath to senators that for the duration of the trial, they swear to administer impartial justice.
sentences.zh: 他自己宣誓，然后让参议员们宣誓，在审判期间，他们发誓要公正地行使司法权。

sentences.en: At that point, the Senate sends a summons to President Trump, telling him formally that he is on trial in the Senate and asking for his answer.
sentences.zh: 届时，参议院将向特朗普总统发出传票，正式告知他正在参议院受审，并要求他作出回应。

sentences.en: The House managers, will get probably up to 24 hours to make their case, spread over three or four days.
sentences.zh: 众议院经理人可能会获得最多24小时的时间来陈述他们的案件，分摊在三到四天内完成。

sentences.en: The president's defense team will get a chance to do the same thing for the same amount of time.
sentences.zh: 总统的辩护团队也将有同样的时间做同样的事情。

sentences.en: And remember, we've yet to hear from those defense lawyers since they declined to take part in the House proceedings.
sentences.zh: 记住，我们还没有听到那些辩护律师的声音，因为他们拒绝参加众议院的程序。

sentences.en: And then after both sides have made their case, senators will have a chance to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 在双方都陈述完案件后，参议员们将有机会提问。

sentences.en: And can they do that out loud this time?
sentences.zh: 这次他们能大声提问吗？

sentences.en: No, that remains in writing.
sentences.zh: 不能，仍然必须以书面形式。

sentences.en: They can put it on pieces of paper and the chief justice will read them allowed.
sentences.zh: 他们可以写在纸上，由首席大法官大声读出来。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But then we'll get to what may be the most interesting part of this trial, which is
sentences.zh: 但接下来我们将进入这场审判中最有趣的部分，也就是

sentences.en: a debate which has already begun over whether or not to call new witnesses and compel new evidence.
sentences.zh: 关于是否传唤新证人和强制提供新证据的辩论，这场辩论已经开始了。

sentences.en: The prosecution and the defense can both put forward motions to call witnesses and senators will get an up or down vote and a simple majority wins.
sentences.zh: 控方和辩方都可以提出传唤证人的动议，参议员们将进行赞成或反对的投票，简单多数票即可获胜。

sentences.en: So Democrats want to call a number of administration witnesses, people like John Bolton or Mick Mulvaney.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人想要传唤一些政府证人，比如约翰·博尔顿或米克·马尔瓦尼。

sentences.en: They need the help of four Republicans if they want to make that happen.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想实现这一目标，就需要四名共和党人的帮助。

sentences.en: And if they do, if they're successful, Republicans are pledging to use their majority to try and call witnesses that may be more favorable to the president.
sentences.zh: 如果他们成功了，共和党人承诺将利用他们的多数席位，试图传唤对总统更有利的证人。

sentences.en: Potentially even
sentences.zh: 甚至可能包括

sentences.en: Hunter Biden, Joe Biden's son, who's at the center of these investigations that Trump and Giuliani and
sentences.zh: 亨特·拜登，乔·拜登的儿子，他处于特朗普、朱利安尼和

sentences.en: Parnas were looking for in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 帕纳斯在乌克兰调查的核心位置。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, a two or three week trial could end up lasting five or six weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，一场两三周的审判最终可能会持续五到六周。

sentences.en: Eventually, when senators have satisfied themselves, they will vote either to convict or quit.
sentences.zh: 最终，当参议员们感到满意时，他们将投票决定定罪或无罪释放。

sentences.en: But remember, you need two thirds of all senators to support conviction, to have the president convicted and removed from office.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，你需要所有参议员的三分之二支持定罪，才能让总统被定罪并免职。

sentences.en: You know, I'm thinking back to what
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在回想佩洛西议长

sentences.en: Speaker Pelosi said during her news conference, that time has been on the side of Democrats, that
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上所说的话，时间一直站在民主党这一边，

sentences.en: the delay in transmitting these articles of impeachment to the Senate and getting this
sentences.zh: 推迟将这些弹劾条款移交给参议院并启动

sentences.en: trial underway there may have shifted the ground when it comes to things like calling witnesses or introducing new evidence and the contours of how this trial will unfold.
sentences.zh: 审判，可能已经改变了局势，特别是在传唤证人或引入新证据以及这场审判将如何展开的轮廓方面。

sentences.en: Do you think that she's right?
sentences.zh: 你认为她是正确的吗？

sentences.en: You know, we won't know for sure for at least a couple of weeks until these votes come up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，至少在接下来的几周内，直到这些投票出现之前，我们无法确定。

sentences.en: But walking around the Senate in the last few days, it certainly seems like there is a growing
